name: sok-context
description: sok context asks agent.surface and surface.window once and prints the configuration directory, the surface and its window, and for a refusal 1014 of agent.surface it prints the configuration directory with surface and window null.
reason: The case answers agent.surface with a surface, and the process of the sok that the test starts belongs to no surface of a running application, so agent.surface refuses it.

refusal.example: process 1 is not a process of a surface: no parent process of it is a running sidecar of the application that started it for a surface
